32.documented_fact: BRCA1 methylation investigated in two ovarian cohorts receiving platinum/taxane.

33.N: 21 methylated cases among 204 trial patients; analyzable subsets differ
33.Methylation_preprocessing: Methylated fraction adjusted for purity and BRCA1 copy number
33.documented_fact: Methylation of all BRCA1 copies and current biopsy status matter; low purity can prevent zygosity inference.
33.inference: A promoter beta cutoff ignores dosage/purity.
33.recommendation: Do not use BRCA1 beta positivity as ground truth.

34.N: 12 patients in methylated cohort; experimental lineages are not independent patients
34.documented_fact: RAD51C methylation loss accompanied restored expression and resistance; scars reflected HRD history.
34.inference: Derived models can evolve repair phenotypes.
34.recommendation: Group lineages; prioritize patient tumors for external testing.

35.N: 7619 analyzed primary cancers; assay-specific source counts differ
35.Ground_truth_HRD_definition: Genomic HRD features and methylation with LOH
35.documented_fact: High-level BRCA1/RAD51C methylation with LOH relates to HRD; lower-level RAD51C methylation in LGG/stomach is often associated with CIMP instead.
35.inference: CNS hypermethylation can confound adult HRD predictors.
35.recommendation: Stratify errors by subtype and purity; do not equate hypermethylation with HRD.

37.Cancer_cohort: TNBC cohorts and TCGA TNBC application
37.N: 32 + 58 specimens (55 unique subjects in second cohort);113 TCGA application
37.Methylation_preprocessing: Separate minfi/ENmix cohort processing; different FFPE detection criteria
37.Model_class: Supervised regression; exact optimized model in unavailable Supplemental Procedures
37.Feature_selection: EWAS described; model-specific nesting not established in main text
37.External_validation: 113 TCGA TNBC; genomic correlates and survival
37.documented_fact: Predicts MLPA BRCAness probability from methylation, not canonical HRDsum. Two biological cohorts support the association; model details are referred to the supplement.
37.inference: Supports plausibility, not validated adult-pan-cancer-to-pediatric regression.
37.recommendation: Obtain supplement before reproducing its tuning; independently implement nested baseline.

40.documented_fact: Retrospective study relates BRCA1 methylation to outcome, with missing GIS and treatment selection.
40.inference: Not validation of a methylation-wide continuous score.

41.documented_fact: Assesses promoter methylation against commercial GII-based HRD.
41.inference: Commercial scales cannot be pooled numerically.

42.Performance_metrics: 740/764 (96.9%) correctly auto-corrected vs manual karyotype review
42.documented_fact: Explicitly notes lack of SNP-array B-allele frequency; this is a baseline correction method.
42.inference: Label-visible manual correction can leak reference information.
42.recommendation: Locked baseline/QC; blind to HRD outcomes.

43.Cross_validation_design: Ten-fold repeated five times; OOB reporting also described
43.documented_fact: MethPed provides saved-forest single-sample classification of pediatric tumor types.
43.inference: Subtype signal is both useful and a potential HRD confounder; nesting must be independently enforced.
43.recommendation: Borrow frozen inference, not accuracy expectations.

45.documented_fact: Integrates methylation, CN profiles and morphology for CNS diagnostics.
45.inference: CN corroboration does not validate HRD.
45.recommendation: Show assay QC and applicability with predictions.

50.N: 119 expression profiles;131 arrays with replicates;methylation subset distinct
50.documented_fact: H3.1/H3.3 epigenetic differences can persist in cultures; text/figure differ in duplicate count.
50.inference: Histone subtype and lineage can dominate methylation distances.
50.recommendation: Group donor models and assess subtype-specific errors.

51.Performance_metrics: 45/50 retrospective correct,5 abstain;18/25 surgery correct,7 below confidence
51.documented_fact: Sturgeon uses sparse simulation and abstention with real validation.
51.inference: Millions of masks do not increase independent biological N.

53.documented_fact: Pilot cross-assay study derives platform-specific confidence threshold.
53.inference: Same-cohort cutoff selection limits external calibration claims.

54.documented_fact: A simple probabilistic classifier enables rapid sparse methylation classification.
54.inference: Large feature space does not itself justify neural networks.

55.Single_sample_compatible: Operational yes; ad hoc forest retraining differs from frozen model
55.documented_fact: Large diagnostic validation; Rapid-CNS2 methods include sample-specific forest retraining.
55.recommendation: Require unchanged model weights in KIDS26.

56.documented_fact: Combines CN and methylation for intraoperative molecular diagnosis.
56.inference: Fusion benefit for HRD remains unproven.
56.recommendation: Evaluate fusion on identical paired samples.

57.Cross_validation_design: Four folds; train/validation/test; separate simulation seeds
57.Performance_metrics: 52 prospective above threshold;96% accuracy among these
57.documented_fact: TUCAN is a preprint with platform intersection and real validation plus rejection.
57.inference: Distinct simulation seeds do not replace original-donor partitioning.
57.recommendation: Use manifest-specific intersection; report coverage with conditional accuracy.

60.documented_fact: Factorized generator ensemble evaluates genomic patterns and downstream classification; subclonal representation limited.
60.inference: Joint CpG-intensity-allelic-CN covariance is not established.

62.Performance_metrics: High binary tumor-vs-normal AUC,not HRD regression
62.documented_fact: SMOTE benefits reported on tumor-vs-normal tasks; reviewed text does not establish complete train-fold nesting.
62.inference: Endpoint ease and unresolved leakage preclude borrowing accuracy claims.

64.N: 26 AML WGBS;93 MDS ERRBS;14 datasets overall
64.Training_strategy: 2.6 million 1 kb windows;26 independent training donors
64.documented_fact: Imputes methylation using local/long-range context; millions of windows are not patients.
64.inference: Imputation quality is not evidence of HRD transfer or label fidelity.
64.recommendation: Defer; train-fold median imputation and dropout tests for MVP.
